channel.title: Duskora.ai blog
channel.description: News, product updates and notes from the Duskora team on building with AI coding agents that turn tickets into reviewed pull requests.

item.title: From sign-up to shipped: your first ticket with Duskora
item.description: A screen-by-screen walkthrough of getting started with Duskora: sign up, add your Anthropic key, connect GitHub, pick a repository and write your first ticket, then watch agents plan, build, review and test it while you approve what ships.

item.title: Welcome to Duskora: your software team, staffed by agents
item.description: Meet Duskora: AI agents that take a ticket from your Linear or Jira board to a reviewed GitHub pull request, and wait for your approval before anything ships. Here is what it does today and how to join the beta.
